mapper.select: SELECT ig.id, ig.title, ig.tag, LEFT(ig.content, 200) AS content, ig.good_count AS goodCount, ig.middle_count AS middleCount, ig.bad_count AS badCount, ig.user_name AS userName FROM osh_info_gap ig WHERE ig.delete_flag = 0 AND ig.status = 4 ORDER BY (ig.good_count * 3 + ig.view_count) DESC, ig.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}
